rationale:
Issue #1504 (labeled bug) reports that tall-style formatting rewrites '
' to '
' inside multi-line strings while short style preserves it. The production fix targets exactly that mechanism: GroupCode._build in lib/src/back_end/code.dart hardcoded newline emission via StringBuffer.writeln(), and the patch replaces it with buffer.write(lineEnding), threading the value through build([String? lineEnding]) (defaulting to '
') and wiring it from the existing DartFormatter option at the single call site in lib/src/front_end/piece_writer.dart (solution.code.build(_formatter.lineEnding)). Both production hunks are on the newline-emission path; the only cosmetic element is the local rename formatter->solver inside the same three modified lines, which disambiguates the local from _formatter now referenced there, and the added doc comment documents the new parameter. No feature extension: DartFormatter.lineEnding already existed and was honored by short style. The trigger is the unchanged upstream test file portion of the same commit; it parameterizes test/dart_formatter_test.dart over short and tall style using pre-existing APIs (DartFormatter constructor params languageVersion/indent/lineEnding and tallStyleExperimentFlag from lib/src/constants.dart), so it does not depend on any API introduced by the fix. Strict evidence records the single reproduced selector as test/dart_formatter_test.dart::'handles Windows line endings in multiline strings', which asserts '
' preservation in a triple-quoted string, semantically the same behavior described in the issue; the other 19 declared selectors pass on the buggy revision. Runtime gates all passed (build.both_versions, trigger.buggy_differential, trigger.deterministic with 3 fingerprint groups, trigger.fixed_clean, full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, full_suite.fixed_all_green) at 3 repetitions and identically post-minimization. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, and dart-lang/dart_style#1504 is in allowed_root_cause_ids.

Issue #1504 (labeled bug) reports that under the tall-style experiment the formatter rewrites '
' inside triple-quoted strings to '
', while short style preserves it. The production fix addresses exactly that mechanism: lib/src/back_end/code.dart replaced the hardcoded StringBuffer.writeln() calls in _NewlineCode handling with buffer.write(lineEnding), threading lineEnding through GroupCode.build/_build, and lib/src/front_end/piece_writer.dart passes the already-existing _formatter.lineEnding into solution.code.build(). The defect is pre-existing at parent 8e7e8910 (the tall-style back end simply never consulted DartFormatter.lineEnding, an option short style already honored), so this is a behavior fix, not a feature. The minimized production patch touches only these two files and contains no test, config, or documentation-only content; the only non-behavioral bits are a doc comment on build() describing the new parameter and a colocated local variable rename formatter->solver inside the three modified lines, neither of which constitutes a separable refactor. The trigger is the unchanged upstream assertion 'handles Windows line endings in multiline strings', which already existed before the commit; the test patch only parameterizes dart_formatter_test.dart to run the existing suite under both styles via the pre-existing tallStyleExperimentFlag and the pre-existing DartFormatter(lineEnding:, indent:, languageVersion:, experimentFlags:) constructor. It exercises DartFormatter's public API rather than the new optional GroupCode.build parameter, and build.both_versions passing confirms the trigger compiles against the buggy revision. Strict evidence shows trigger.buggy_differential reproducing exactly that one selector, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (3 fingerprint groups over 3 repetitions), full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, and full_suite.fixed_all_green, with no failed checks in either strict_original or strict_post_minimization. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-lang/dart_style#1504 is the supplied allowed root cause key.
